acceptable_fixes: Call bpf_preempt_enable() before bpf_copy_from_user and avoid re-entering the critical section unnecessarily.

canonical_fix: Move bpf_copy_from_user outside the bpf_preempt_disable/bpf_preempt_enable region, or re-enable preemption before calling it.

The critical section must not contain sleepable operations
